faqs.question: Are there any seat reservations at Aditya Engineering College?
faqs.answer: Yes, there are seat reservations available at Aditya Engineering College. The college provides seat reservations for students belonging to Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes, Other Backward Classes, Divyangjan, etc., as per the reservation policy during the year. The reservation policy is implemented as per the norms set by the Government of India and the AP State Government. Seats are allotted according to the applicant's secured marks in the concerned qualifying exams. For management quota admissions, selections are based on merit. The reserved category candidates are relaxed by 5% of the minimum percentile in the last qualifying exam.

faqs.question: What is the average package offered at Aditya Engineering College?
faqs.answer: Aditya Engineering College placements cell conducts numerous programs that make the students acquire the skills required to get placed in reputed companies. The main thing was in college itself you can improve different techincal skills by joining in technical hub. The highest package in 2022 was INR 29 LPA offered by Amazon. The top recruiters were TCS, Genpact, Infosys, Capgemini, Deloitte, Amazon, Wipro, among others.

faqs.question: How many marks are required for MCA at Aditya Engineering College?
faqs.answer: Candidates must have graduated in computer applications, computer science, or a related field with a minimum of 50% aggregate in order to be admitted to the MCA program at Aditya Engineering College. You also need to qualify for the APICET exam and participate in the counselling process. The cutoff for the MCA course varies every year depending on the number of applicants, seats available, difficulty level of the exam, etc.

college_info.intro:
The Aditya Engineering College offers many courses at the undergraduate, postgraduate, and doctoral levels through its various departments such as Civil Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electronics and Communication Engineering, and Computer Science & Engineering, and several others.
At the UG level, AEC offers the BTech and BE programmes in the Civil Engineering, Electrical and Electronics Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Computer Science and Engineering and several others.

The college has also established multiple partnerships to regularly organise industry-driven training and certification programmes, internship opportunities, and industry visits for students.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning - Batch of 2027
reviews_list.review_title: It is a good college with an amazing environment and facilities.

review_content.Placements: My seniors from the 2021–2025 B.Tech (CSE) batch have around 80% of students placed. Salary packages start from about 3 LPA and go up to 18 LPA, with an average of 6 LPA. Major recruiters include TCS, Infosys, Wipro, and Accenture. Nearly 65 percent of students secure internships in companies like Infosys, TCS, and various startups. Common roles offered are software developer, analyst, and QA engineer.
review_content.Infrastructure: The department offers Wi-Fi-enabled classrooms, modern computer labs, smart boards, and a well-stocked central library with digital access. Hostels are clean and well-maintained. Along with reliable water and power. Mess food is decent and hygienic. Medical facilities, sports grounds, a gym, and indoor games are also available. It makes campus life comfortable.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning - Batch of 2027
reviews_list.review_title: Absolutely good faculty and placements.

review_content.Placements: In my course, around 30percent of students got placed. The highest package is 5.6 LPA, and the lowest package is 2.6 LPA. The recruiting company is Wipro. In my college, we have almost 75 percent of students got internships. The top offered roles are 3D modeler, 3D animator, and video editor.
review_content.Infrastructure: The facility is so good, with so much more knowledge of the course. We have Wi-Fi and labs also in the college, and a decent library. The quality of facilities in the percentage we get is 90 percent. They don't have offline sports, and no games are also in college.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning - Batch of 2027
reviews_list.review_title: Good infrastructure and facilities with 100 percent placements.

review_content.Placements: In my particular course, we have almost 70 percent of students. In my course, the highest package is around 5 LPA, and the lowest package is almost 3.6 LPA. The top recruiting companies that have been in my course include Wipro, TCS, and Infosys. In my class, 80 percent of students got the internships from AI.
review_content.Infrastructure: The facilities are good and way more impressive. The Wi-Fi is also available in the college and labs, and in my free time, I also have to go to the library. The quality of the facilities is too good and friendly. The food is not too good but okay, and the sports have a great option at my college.

reviews_list.batch_info: M.Tech. in Thermal Engineering - Batch of 2028
reviews_list.review_title: It has good faculty members with high knowledge and good infrastructure.

review_content.Placements: We are going to pass out in 2028 from the Computer Science department. There is a technical training center called Thub in our college, and they train us to become job-ready. The highest package offered is 52 LPA, and the main placement operations are handled by Thub only. We have to pay an extra fee to Thub other than the college fee.
review_content.Infrastructure: The internet in the hostel is not good, and the majority of the time, we cannot get internet. The remaining facilities are good. The electricity bill must be paid by us only, and it is not covered in the hostel fee. Classrooms are digitalised, and we get high-speed internet in classrooms. The library is well-organised with many useful books.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering (Data Science) - Batch of 2028
reviews_list.review_title: I am satisfied with the campus and college atmosphere. Overall, it is good.

review_content.Placements: In Aditya Engineering College, the highest package offered is 60 LPA, and the lowest package offered is 5 LPA. In our course, 70 percent of students joined. 80 percent of students got internships at Japan, Tech Mahindra, and other companies through our college.
review_content.Infrastructure: In Aditya Engineering College, every classroom has a Wi-Fi facility. Classrooms are also very neat. The Aditya Engineering College library is provided for students. Our college's mess food is good. Sports are also conducted in the college and hostel.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning - Batch of 2028
reviews_list.review_title: This college provides good placements.

review_content.Placements: The placement percentage is high in our college. 70 percent of students are placed in our college. The highest package offered is 30 LPA, the lowest package offered is 3 to 4 LPA, and the average package offered is 5 LPA. The top companies like Amazon, TCL, Cognizant, Google, etc, are hiring. Most of the students got internships.
review_content.Infrastructure: The facilities are excellent, and all resources like labs, Wi-Fi, and many others are available. Advanced facilities are also available. The quality of the hostel is poor when compared to other colleges. The hostel fee is high, and the mess and canteen are average.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Civil Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: The faculty is decent and college infrastructure is average.

content.Placements: In our batch, nearly 65%-70% of the students from civil engineering got placed, while others opted for higher studies or government exam preparation. The highest package offered in our course is around 12 LPA, the lowest is about 3.5 LPA, and the average package is around 5 LPA - 6 LPA. Top recruiting companies included L&T, TCS, Wipro, Accenture, and some core construction firms like Shapoorji Pallonji and GMR. Around 40% of students managed to get internships, mainly through companies like L&T, PWD, and private consultancies.
content.Infrastructure: Department provides a decent infrastructure with classrooms, a well-maintained library, Wi-Fi availability, and laboratories equipped with essential instruments for practical learning. Hostel infrastructure is satisfactory, with proper accommodation facilities, but improvements can still be made in cleanliness and maintenance. Mess food is average and manageable, with both vegetarian and non-vegetarian options. Medical facilities are available within the campus, and a nearby hospital adds to the convenience. Sports grounds for cricket, football, and volleyball, along with indoor games, are available, providing students with good opportunities for recreation and fitness.

review_summary.college_name: MU Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: Diploma in Elementary Education (D.EL.ED.) - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: This university helps every middle class student and gives them the right education.

content.Placements: There are many students placed in various institutes. The highest placement package is 5 LPA and the lowest placement package is 1 LPA. There are many institutional visits yearly, etc. Every student can do an internship as they want and apply where they choose.
content.Infrastructure: There are many facilities available on the campus, and for each department, every classroom has Wi-Fi. There are labs for each department. Classrooms are very big and well-furnished. There are certified and digital libraries and every department has a separate library and the sitting area is good. There are good quality facilities in the hostel. The food quality is like home. There is a hospital also available on campus. There are also many sports grounds like cricket, football, volleyball, badminton and indoor games also available like table tennis, chess and many others.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Pharmacy (B.Pharm.) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Good infrastructure and the highest package is about 2 crores. There is a good placement ratio.

content.Placements: This university has a great placement ratio of 99.99%. Many companies visit and take placements of students. In my course, Cipla, Sunpharma, and many top companies visit the university. All students have 100% done their internship. In the last year, 26 LPA was the highest package, and the lowest was 8 LPA. This is a very good ratio for all of these courses.
content.Infrastructure: There is strong Wi-Fi connectivity. There are new and highly equipped labs. All classrooms are good. There is a smart board in every class. There is a certified library. The hostel is very clean and hygienic. The food quality is very good, with an FSO-certified mess. There is a hospital. There are many playgrounds for different games, and indoor games are also available.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: There is a very good faculty and better placement than other universities and it is very cheap.

content.Placements: In my college, approximately 60 to 70% of students are placed every year. The highest package is 50 LPA, and the lowest is 3 LPA to 4 LPA. Every 3rd year, students get a chance to work as interns from our college. In this college, new courses are also offered, and they prepared us for the interview.
content.Infrastructure: There are many classrooms and labs. There is also library in which we study from morning to evening at 8 o'clock. There are very good facilities in our hostel. There are many available sports like volleyball, football, badminton, cricket, chess, kho, kabaddi, and many more. Mess is also very good, and food quality is good.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Pharmacy (B.Pharm.) - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: I am disappointed with their placement promises.

content.Placements: Placements in this college are very bad. In my batch time, only 2 pharma companies from Gujarat came to my college, and they collected resumes only. They did not provide any placements. At the start of the course, the college talked a lot about their placement partner, but at last, no placement companies came to this college.
content.Infrastructure: Actually, the college infrastructure is very good. Hostels are also good, but the food quality is not good. Classrooms are very good. Labs are also good for experiments, and the library is very well-managed. For all departments, a separate library is available.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Pharmacy (B.Pharm.) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: I am always thankful to my college, which gives me a better platform for my future.

content.Placements: Every year, about 70-80% of students get placed in the top companies like Cadila, Zydus, Macleods, Helios, and Claroid Cipla. Students get paced with the salary package that ranges from 4-5 LPA. Almost 100% of students got internships after completing their courses. Sometimes in mid-sessions, students get placed in MNC companies.
content.Infrastructure: Good labs and library facilities are available. Wi-Fi facilities are available in the hostel and library also. Hot water is also available in the hostel during the winter season. The environment of my college is evergreen. Separate boys and girls hostels are available. Mess is well-mannered. The food of the mess is awesome.

Hence, it can be considered that Mewar University admission is entrance-based for most of its courses. Students are required to go through the university-conducted and national-level or state-level entrances and then appear for the university-level selection rounds for final admission. Aspirants need to pay a course fee to confirm their seat in the university.

A candidate has to have 45% marks in Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics at least. Furthermore, this college also considers the scores of JEE Main exam for admissions in the college. overview_faqs.question: Why choose VIT Bhopal?
overview_faqs.answer: VIT Bhopal is a private university and was established in 2017. It is located in Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh and is spread over a huge campus of 250 acres. Vellore Institute of Technology Bhopal organises various interactive sessions and seminars of industry experts with the help of partner universities and alumni. In addition to this, the university provides placement assistance to students in top-notch companies such as Microsoft, Palo Alto, Intel, eBay, Amazon, Dell, GE, Texas Instruments, etc.

overview_faqs.question: Is M.Tech available at VIT Bhopal?
overview_faqs.answer: Yes, VIT Bhopal offers a full-time MTech in three specialisations. The duration of the PG-level courses is two years. VIT Bhopal MTech courses include M.Tech in VLSI Design, M.Tech CSE in Cyber Security & Digital Forensics, and M.Tech CSE in AI & Data Science. The eligibility requirement for these courses is a minimum aggregate of 60% in a relevant qualifying exam (depending on the choice of specialisation). For more information, candidates can visit the institute's official website.

overview_faqs.question: What is the fee for BTech at VIT Bhopal?
overview_faqs.answer: VIT Bhopal offers a number of courses across unique streams such as Architecture and Planning, Business and Management Studies, Engineering, IT and Software, Humanities and Social Science and Banking, Finance and Insurance. The total tuition fees of BTech programme at VIT Bhopal ranges between INR 4.8 Lacs and INR 7.9 lakh.

review_summary.college_name: VIT Bhopal Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering (Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning) - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Needs some improvement, till then it's just fine.

content.Placements: To be honest, the placements are for those who score a good CGPA and have a good profile in 10th and 12th, others need to have a very good skill-based profile, or else you won't get the placement you are expecting. If you have all of this, then you will get a good placement.
content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi is available 24/7, but some websites are blocked by the administration office, classrooms are average, some have ACs, some don't. The food quality of the mess is average, sometimes it's good, sometimes it's very bad. Sports and medical facilities are where the college lacks, they need to work on it.

individual_reviews.course: Integrated M.Tech. in Artificial Intelligence - Batch of 2030
individual_reviews.title: Amazing college, I'm totally satisfied because of the fantastic environment and good infrastructure.

content.Placements: If I talk about the percentage of students who were placed, 90% students get good placement in good companies. The highest package for 2026 is 70 LPA, and the average package is approximately 9 to 10 LPA. Top recruiters are Microsoft, Amazon, Infosys, IBM, etc. The top roles are AI and ML engineer, data scientist and cybersecurity officer.
content.Infrastructure: The facilities and infrastructure are good. We get a Wi-Fi facility, labs, many classrooms and a special library. The hostel facility is good, the quality of food available in the mess and canteen, and we can choose according. Medical facilities, sports and games are also available for everyone.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Aerospace Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Top choice for its education.

content.Placements: 80% of students have accepted good offers. The highest was 56 LPA, the lowest was 4 LPA, and the average was 9 LPA. TCS and Wipro are the top recruiters. Hardly any paid internships, but a lot of unpaid internships are available. Mostly taken for training and then assigned roles according to the training.
content.Infrastructure: The Wi-Fi speed is fair, but it serves the purpose. 1080p streaming is possible. At most, 2 devices can be connected at a time. Labs are very nice, and they have the latest technology in every area. The infrastructure is not yet completed, but still, it is good. The hostels are of good standard, the food served in the mess is good, and no ragging is allowed.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering (Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning) - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: My college is perfect for me. Faculty members are good and understanding in nature.

content.Placements: In my branch, around 90% students were placed, and the highest package was around 32 LPA, and the average package was 10LPA, which I think was good. The top recruiter was from Tata. My batch is a competitive batch, students are passionate and innovative. I think there is tough competition, which will lead to better opportunities.
content.Infrastructure: My hostel facilities are really good, there is proper sanitation, food is edible, there are regular cleaning services, and the furniture is also good. Also, the facilities provided are excellent, and all this creates a good environment for studying, and I think this is the best that can be provided by any institution.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Dissatisfied with facilities, great teachers.

content.Placements: I am from the 2023 batch, and there are about 4000-5000 students in the placement line. The highest package the university received in 2026 was 56 LPA. The top recruiting companies are TCS, Zomato, Amazon, and Microsoft. Currently, very few students are getting internships from college due to the central placement policy, and I believe only 5-10% can secure internships. Most roles offered are software engineer and full-stack software Engineer.
content.Infrastructure: There are facilities available like labs, Wi-Fi, and classrooms. The main issue is Wi-Fi, which is extremely slow and often does not work. Classrooms and labs are standard, except for the architecture block, which is the worst- an extremely poorly maintained building. Hostel facilities are also poor; Wi-Fi often does not work, there is no network, and mobile data speeds are very low. Mess facilities like JMB, Mayuri, and Safal are of better quality, but CRCL is the worst mess. Regarding hostel infrastructure, the premium blocks don't feel premium, and the basic ones are actually better.

faqs.question: Is VIT Bhopal hard to get?
faqs.answer: VIT Bhopal offers a variety of courses at undergraduate, postgraduate, and doctoral levels in the fields of Management, Engineering, Science, Architecture, etc. For each of the above-mentioned streams, only a limited number of seats for its courses. Shortlisted students may get called for counselling. To confirm seat at VIT Bhopal, students need to pay the admission fees.

reviews.review_heading: Needs some improvement, till then it's just fine.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is available 24/7, but some websites are blocked by the administration office, classrooms are average, some have ACs, some don't. The food quality of the mess is average, sometimes it's good, sometimes it's very bad. Sports and medical facilities are where the college lacks, they need to work on it.

reviews.review_heading: Amazing college, I'm totally satisfied because of the fantastic environment and good infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure are good. We get a Wi-Fi facility, labs, many classrooms and a special library. The hostel facility is good, the quality of food available in the mess and canteen, and we can choose according. Medical facilities, sports and games are also available for everyone.

reviews.review_heading: Top choice for its education.
reviews.review_text: The Wi-Fi speed is fair, but it serves the purpose. 1080p streaming is possible. At most, 2 devices can be connected at a time. Labs are very nice, and they have the latest technology in every area. The infrastructure is not yet completed, but still, it is good. The hostels are of good standard, the food served in the mess is good, and no ragging is allowed.

reviews.review_heading: My college is perfect for me. Faculty members are good and understanding in nature.
reviews.review_text: My hostel facilities are really good, there is proper sanitation, food is edible, there are regular cleaning services, and the furniture is also good. Also, the facilities provided are excellent, and all this creates a good environment for studying, and I think this is the best that can be provided by any institution.

reviews.review_heading: Dissatisfied with facilities, great teachers.
reviews.review_text: There are facilities available like labs, Wi-Fi, and classrooms. The main issue is Wi-Fi, which is extremely slow and often does not work. Classrooms and labs are standard, except for the architecture block, which is the worst- an extremely poorly maintained building. Hostel facilities are also poor; Wi-Fi often does not work, there is no network, and mobile data speeds are very low. Mess facilities like JMB, Mayuri, and Safal are of better quality, but CRCL is the worst mess. Regarding hostel i...

reviews.review_heading: VIT Bhopal University is overall good for academic growth.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi speed is not very good, but it gets the work done. 1080p streaming is possible. The devices can be connected at the same time. Labs are above average. The campus is still under development. New buildings are being made. Hostels are good, the mess food is decent, and there is no ragging.

reviews.review_heading: The campus is equipped with all necessary facilities, and hostel life is excellent with good food.
reviews.review_text: The campus is well-equipped with labs for every course that needs them. Classrooms are equipped with projectors and whiteboards in well-lit conditions. The college has 2 libraries. The campus has 2 girls' hostels and 8 boys' hostels with good food quality, a clinic that is open 24/7, and cricket and football grounds. We also have indoor and outdoor badminton courts, basketball courts, and table tennis tables.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied with mess and hostel, decent placements, facilities not too good, but enough.
reviews.review_text: There are facilities like 4 different messes. AI lab, gaming lab, cyber lab, computer network lab, six different types of airy classrooms, 2 libraries, both have a capacity of 500 each, three auditoriums, cricket ground, football ground, and a small hospital.

reviews.review_heading: VIT Bhopal's Gaming branch is good enough to provide exposure to the gaming industry.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi isn’t the best, but it gets the work done; 1080p streams or Zoom calls will get you through. Every classroom has projectors, and the labs are equipped with the latest PCs and various AR and VR equipment. The infrastructure is still under development, but it’s good. The hostels are good, and new ones are still being built, so far, 8 hostels have been constructed. The mess food is generally good, though there are times when it doesn’t taste great, but most of the time, it’s good enough.

reviews.review_heading: Review of VIT Bhopal University. The best college in North India.
reviews.review_text: While the Wi-Fi speed is not very good, it gets the work done and allows for 1080p streaming on two devices simultaneously, and although the overall infrastructure is still under development, the labs are good and fully equipped with the latest technology, with the hostels being good, the mess food being good, and no ragging.

reviews.review_heading: Review of VIT Bhopal University.
reviews.review_text: The amenities are basic. There are labs for each branch. Wi-Fi speed is decent. There are two libraries, one in AB1 and the other in AB2. The hostel quality is also decent. The mess food is relatively good. Medical facilities are available 24/7. For sports, there is a basketball court, a multipurpose hall, and one at the boys’ hostel.

reviews.review_heading: Disgusting infrastructure, but good reach of the college for placements.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms are non-AC. Hostels are not well-built. Even the roads are being constructed. Boys need to walk about 20 minutes to reach college from hostel. College has Wi-Fi all over the campus, libraries, and other necessary things needed in a college.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied because of campus life, placement, and faculty.
reviews.review_text: There is a big, lush green campus with good Wi-Fi. There are 2 libraries and a classroom that has a smartboard. Quality of food is hygienic and healthy. There is a hospital on campus with full equipment and medicine. There is a big ground for sports.

reviews.review_heading: VIT is a respected college nationwide, truly worth joining. I am happy with my decision.
reviews.review_text: Labs are modern with a good infrastructure. Hostel and mess are average but a bit expensive. Every machine is available. Lab sessions at VIT are really enthusiastic and exciting. Libraries are good. Every type of book is present, from science fiction to academics to comics.

reviews.review_heading: Dissatisfied with playing grounds and cricket nets.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi on campus is good, but sometimes doesn't give internet for some period of time, so you can not play games using the college Wi-Fi. For every course, a new class is assigned. There are now two libraries, one in the academic block 1 and the other in academic block 2, and both are good.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Good infrastructure, supportive faculty, and decent placement opportunities.

content.Placements: Placements for my batch are decent but depend a lot on students’ skills and preparation. Around 65-70% of students from our course get placed through campus drives. The highest package offered is around 10 LPA to 12 LPA, while the lowest package is about 3 LPA to 3.5 LPA. The average package ranges between 4.5 LPA to 5 LPA. Top recruiting companies include TCS, Accenture, Cognizant, Wipro, Deloitte, EY, Capgemini, and Infosys. About 60% of students also receive internship opportunities in companies like Deloitte, EY, Accenture, and startups, mostly in software engineering roles.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Overall, it's a good college.

content.Placements: Mostly, students get placed, as I have heard from my seniors. The average package is okay, with a median of 7 LPA, and the highest goes around 21 LPA. Mostly, students get internships here. Some of the recruiting companies that visit include Accenture, Infosys, JP Morgan, etc. Mostly, the roles offered are SDE, business analyst, etc.
content.Infrastructure: The classrooms are nice, and we get Wi-Fi in the classrooms too. I personally love the library, it's just perfect. Hostels are great, to be honest, infrastructure-wise, they can be very strict for girls, though. Few have study rooms even. Food is great, there's so much variety, and it keeps changing every once in a while. A few hostels have a badminton and basketball court very close to them, if you are lucky enough.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: KIIT is a decent college when it comes to private colleges.

content.Placements: At the end of the placement season, the majority of the students are placed, but the roles of their jobs are typically non-tech, as for the campus placement, usually tech roles are comparatively less. The non- tech jobs are usually consultancy and marketing. As far as the package is concerned, it ranges from 2.5 LPA-61 LPA.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure-wise, it stands taller than several other colleges, i.e., tier 1,2, and 3. Hostel facilities are pretty good. When it comes to Wi-Fi speed, it is a little turbulent, while lab facilities are good when it comes to the computer science branch, but for electronics-based branches, things have deteriorated in the last couple of years. A new campus has been constructed with great facilities, be it the canteen, mess, or any aspect you name it.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: My honest KIIT experience, worth it if you're focused, average placement, good infrastructure.

content.Placements: As a KIIT student, first of all, I feel it’s an above-average university in India in terms of infrastructure and facilities. The top recruiting company in 2025 was Accenture, which offered around 11 LPA to 285-300 students. There are around 4,000-4,200 students in my batch, with about 50-60 sections. Around 1,000 students got packages of more than 10 LPA. The lowest is around 3-4-5-6 LPA. The average is around 8-8.5 LPA. What I honestly feel is that if someone studies well and maintains a GPA of around 8-9+ while also gaining some industry-level skills to add to their CV, then it’s definitely worth joining KIIT.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Information Technology - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: My college review, IT department, for sure we need to improve, but we are doing great, key insights.

content.Placements: The companies mainly come for placement in the 7 th sem in the 4th year. For the 3rd year, companies start coming after the summer vacation ends at the start of the 5 th sem, in our batch 2027, the 1st company was BNY, Cisco, and Dell. BNY had a 7 CGPA criteria, but the cutoff for Dell was very high, about 9.3 in the IT department.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is excellent in our university. From the start of the 5 th semester onwards, the whole school of computer engineering has been shifted to the new campus 25. On campus, 25 majorly 2 and 3rd and 4th year students' classes are held. It is divided into 3 blocks A, B, and C. We have Wi-Fi Labs for our lab classes, and the new library is also present in the C block. The hostel depends on the type of room you want AC or without non AC. Campus 25 has AC premium hostels. Non-AC hostels are kp 6, kp 1.

reviews.review_heading: Decent college, if the intake of students is less, I think it can excel more.

overview_faqs.answer: SAGE University BArch fees at the Indore campus is INR 3.5 lakh.

overview_faqs.question: Is SAGE University a good university?
overview_faqs.answer: Yes, SAGE University is a good university as it is recognised by both the UGC and the AICTE. The university is also accredited by NAAC with an A+ grade and has another campus, SAGE University Bhopal. Further, SAGE University Indore was set up as a private university by the Madhya Pradesh Private University Act in 2007. It offers 100+ UG, PG, diploma, and PhD programmes across 15 multi-disciplinary institutes.

overview_faqs.question: What is the hostel fee for BSc at SAGE University?
overview_faqs.answer: BSc at SAGE University provides hostel accommodation for students who are traveling to Indore for their BSc education. The hostel rooms are provided as non-AC rooms and AC rooms. The annual cost of a non-AC room is INR 47,000 and the annual cost of an AC room is INR 60,000.Candidates can also avail of bus services offered by the university, which are on a sliding scale of annual fees of INR 15,000 to 21,000 depending on the distance the bus service is needed.

overview_faqs.question: Is SAGE University Indore NAAC accredited?
overview_faqs.answer: Yes, SAGE University Indore received an excellent A+ NAAC accreditation with a CGPA of 3.41 on a 4 point scale. This rating depends on many different categories with its top performing metrics being Curricular Aspects, Institutional Values & Best Practices and Infrastructure & Learning Resources.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech in Computer Science and Engineering (Lateral Entry) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: The college is nice, and I recommend choosing it for studies.

content.Placements: Around 50–60 percent of students in the course get placed. The highest package offered is 20–25 LPA, while the lowest package is about 6–8 LPA. The average package is around 10–15 LPA. About 50–60 percent of students got internships.
content.Infrastructure: The college provides good facilities. Wi-Fi works smoothly. Labs are neat and clean for both students and teaching staff. Classrooms are of good quality. They are neat and clean The library remains silent during study hours. The college does not have a hostel.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Computer Applications (MCA) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Overall, a good experience in MCA at SAGE University.

content.Placements: The MCA course provided decent placement opportunities. Approximately 60 percent of our batch students have been placed. The average package was around 3-4 LPA, and the highest package offered was about 8 LPA, while the lowest was around 2.5 LPA. Companies like TCS, Infosys, Wipro, Accenture, Cognizant, and some smaller IT companies visited the campus. reviews.review_heading: SAGE University  review.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the course is good and supports both theoretical and practical learning. The classrooms are modern classrooms with a snart board and the classroom is spacious and well equipped and there are also projectors and hostel facilities are decent and comfortable for students. The rooms are clean and regularly maintained, and the mess food is average.

reviews.review_heading: It has some great infrastructure and living life; I think it is great for starting my college life.
reviews.review_text: I think the college infrastructure is quite good. It has great things like a stage, sports complex, and basketball courts. The hostel rooms are nice and have great facilities like cleaning services, toilet services, room cleaning, and mess (food and lunch).

reviews.review_heading: Reality of SAGE University, Indore.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is great. It is built above the mountains, and it looks very beautiful in the rainy season. It has a great library. In the library, we also get the Wi-Fi connection, but the network in the college is not that good. Currently, they are upgrading. It also has a hostel with Wi-Fi and clean facilities. The mess food is average.

reviews.review_heading: Stage University is worth taking admission and is a value for money.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure for our course is actually pretty solid. Classrooms are clean and well-maintained. Labs have all the essential equipment we need for AI ML work. The campus Wi-Fi can be a little moody sometimes, but most of the time it's fast enough to get things done. Hostel life is decent too. Rooms are okay in size, and the common areas are regularly cleaned. The mess food is like normal college mess food, and it's not amazing.

reviews.review_heading: The college has great infrastructure, good faculty, and placements.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is not so cool, but there exist some labs like Apple Lab, Nvidia Lab, etc. Digital boards are in some classrooms. The quality of the hostel is good enough most of the time. The food is good, sometimes it is not good, and there is a dedicated sports complex in the college for sports purpose.

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure and best faculty with great experience.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure are amazing. There are 11 to 15 departments, and each department has its own labs, classrooms, faculty members, and facilities. There is a central library. Sports, games, mess, and canteen facilities are also highly advanced.

reviews.review_heading: Good potential, but it needs an infrastructure upgrade and a better placement cell.
reviews.review_text: Our department had very good Wi-Fi, modern classrooms, fully equipped labs, and a well-stocked library. The hostel was clean and comfortable with good security. The mess and canteen provided tasty, hygienic food. Medical facilities were reliable. The campus offered great sports and games facilities.

reviews.review_heading: It is absolutely nice and well.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and the infrastructure are available in the course, and the department's Wi-Fi is in good condition. The labs are also in a neat and clean condition. The classrooms are also neat and clean for students and staff, and the library is so silent for study purposes.

reviews.review_text: Facilities like classrooms are neat and clean. Wi-Fi runs very smoothly and is available for students and staff. The University of Calcutta popular programmes are BTech, BCom, BSc, and MBA. These courses are further offered across multiple specialisations in full-time mode. The university tries to inspire the students to contribute to the sustainable development of society & nation through education, professionalism, research, & public and social services. University of Calcutta popular programme students are currently involved in Business Development, Operations, etc sectors.
The University of Calcutta BTech and MBA students are placed in top companies across sectors including TCS, Cognizant, Wipro, etc. It is one of the top universities offering quality education to students. faqs.answer: No, you cannot get admission at a rank of 7000 at Calcutta University. The Calcutta University cutoff 2024 for the BTech courses at the undergraduate level has been released upto Round 3 seat allotment results. review_summary.college_name: Calcutta University Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.A. LL.B. - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: Cost-effective Law College.

content.Placements: There was no placement cell (at least for Calcutta University Department of Law). There was a common placement cell by the University, but it was not that useful when it came to specific legal placements. We students tried to create a placement committee, perhaps it was still active, but it was only student-run. For internships, students had to fend for themselves. Again, there was no support from the college. If there was any requirement from the organizations providing internship to a student of the college, such requirements were not fulfilled by the college.

individual_reviews.course: B. Com. (Hons.) in Accounting and Finance - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Great college ambience, solid faculty, the worst part is getting placements here.

content.Placements: Students are barely placed from this college. We might get internship certificates and results, but placements are hard to get. Packages, if somehow mentioned, are around 3–3.5 LPA. Kotak, Bajaj, etc., are recruiters. The placement percentage is around 7–8 percent or less. The course is the best thing to choose. Currently pursuing this course in this college can help you go through with better reputation and skills.
content.Infrastructure: Facilities are basic but helpful for students. It provides a computer lab, Wi-Fi features, a canteen with good food, a college library, and a ground to play. Our college may have medical facilities, but I haven’t seen any emergencies yet, so I’d rather not believe whether this facility is there or not. Sports and games get more attention, and that’s right. It has annual sports with a wide variety, and day-to-day sports can also be played on the ground.

individual_reviews.course: B.Com. in Accounting and Finance - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: If you are from Bengal medium, then you can take this course. Otherwise, skip this college.

content.Placements: At Sir Gurudas Mahavidyalaya, B.Com (Hons) placements are modest. About 25% of students got placed directly. The average package is around 2.5 LPA, with local firms being the top recruiters. Most students focus on professional courses like CA, CMA, or CS. Internships are mostly self-sourced in local accounting firms.
content.Infrastructure: The college has no campus or hostel. The library mostly has account books. Other commerce subjects are missing. Wi-Fi is available, but doesn't work as it's BSNL. No one stays in PGs; it's mostly for locals. The canteen is basic with limited food. Food is not tasty.

individual_reviews.course: B.A. LL.B. - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Feels budget friendly, well-reputed, campus and crowd are quite good.

content.Placements: The number of students recruited every year varies and is significantly on the lower side. There is no scope for campus placements, as the university and college do not commence them. Students mainly make connections by joining multiple internships or through second (or more) generation lawyer friends by contacting their relatives.
content.Infrastructure: Our college does not have a hostel or canteen. The classrooms and library are clean and well maintained. The condition of the washrooms is quite bad and unhygienic. The college is a 6-storey building, and it has a well-functioning lift with a capacity of about 400 kgs. There is no scope for games, no playgrounds and no dedicated indoor gaming rooms. There is a gym, but it is as good as useless.

individual_reviews.course: B.A. in Political Science - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Great value for money, very safe for women. Infrastructure is also great.

content.Placements: Various companies send their HR or people from their company to our college for placements and recruitment. They give a training session where if students attend at least 75 to 80 percent of the training sessions, it is easier for them to get internships in these companies, and if they do well, they even get a letter of recommendation and get placed for a job in these companies.
content.Infrastructure: All of the classrooms are smart with smart boards, mic, and other facilities. It is also air-conditioned, although there is only one building, yet all the rooms are well-equipped. There is a library, a physical one, and also an e-library, and there are more than 3-4 labs that have Mac computers and other facilities.

admission_process.title: Calcutta University Admission Process 2025

paragraphs: Admission 2025 to Calcutta University is based on a merit basis and also through various entrance tests. The step-by-step process for admission to the university is presented below:Step 1: Application ProcessThe admission process at Calcutta University starts with the application process.Applicants are to log into the official website and download their application forms for university admission. Later on, application forms duly filled have to be sent via post or submitted in person to the respective department in CU. However, candidates applying for this must consider that application and test examination entrance fees shall be paid online only.The candidates would attach the pay slip along with two copies of online bank challan with the application form.Step 2: Selection RoundsAdmission to different UG, PG, and doctoral level programs at Calcutta University is done through distinct selection methodology for different courses.In case of all the undergraduate courses including the programs like BSc, BA, and BCom, CUJ offers admission in merit basis, depending on the scores obtained in the last qualifying exam. Similarly, for all the postgraduate courses, which include MA and MCom, the entry is provided on a merit basis.In case of all the professional courses such as BE/BTech and MBA/PGDM, entrance exams, namely WBJEE and CAT/MAT/XAT/JEMAT respectively are conducted for admission.Step 3: Merit List Release & CounsellingAfter all the selection rounds get completed, candidates thereafter go for counselling regarding their respective courses.

Calcutta University offers a limited number of seats for its offered courses. Seats are allocated as per course-wise counselling. Further, Calcutta University fees range from INR 40,00 to INR 5 lakh. The fees include multiple components such as admission fees, convocation fees, alumni fees, etc. Candidates must pay the fees to finalise their seats in the Institute. library.description: The University of Calcutta  library, has a collection of more than ten lakh books. Besides books, the seven campuses of the University together possess more than 2 lakh volumes of bound journals, M.Phil. and Ph.D. dissertations, proceedings of conferences, reports, maps, standards, patents, newspapers, manuscripts, microfilms, CD-ROMs. As many as 20 departmental libraries out of a total of 39, have a collection of over 15,000 volumes which includes books, bound journals and non-book materials. The Department of Law Library holds over 85,000 volumes in hard copy. The collection is strong in all aspects with special emphasis on legal history and jurisprudence, business and commercial law, taxation and international business transactions.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2023Offered by Faculty of Law, University of CalcuttaReviewed on 21 Jan 2026)
reviews.review_heading: Cost-effective Law College.
reviews.review_text: Hostel facilities were available for students coming from a good enough distance. An application had to be made for availing such facilities. Hostels were cost-effective. As to the infrastructure, the highlight was the library, one of the best law libraries in Kolkata. Classrooms were moderate for a government university.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2028Offered by Heramba Chandra CollegeReviewed on 18 Jan 2026)
reviews.review_heading: Great college ambience, solid faculty, the worst part is getting placements here.
reviews.review_text: Facilities are basic but helpful for students. It provides a computer lab, Wi-Fi features, a canteen with good food, a college library, and a ground to play. Our college may have medical facilities, but I haven’t seen any emergencies yet, so I’d rather not believe whether this facility is there or not. Sports and games get more attention, and that’s right. It has annual sports with a wide variety, and day-to-day sports can also be played on the ground.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2029Offered by Sir Gurudas MahavidyalayaReviewed on 17 Jan 2026)
reviews.review_heading: If you are from Bengal medium, then you can take this course. Otherwise, skip this college.
reviews.review_text: The college has no campus or hostel. The library mostly has account books. Other commerce subjects are missing. Wi-Fi is available, but doesn't work as it's BSNL. No one stays in PGs; it's mostly for locals. The canteen is basic with limited food. Food is not tasty.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2029Offered by South Calcutta Law CollegeReviewed on 6 Jan 2026)
reviews.review_heading: Feels budget friendly, well-reputed, campus and crowd are quite good.
reviews.review_text: Our college does not have a hostel or canteen. The classrooms and library are clean and well maintained. The condition of the washrooms is quite bad and unhygienic. The college is a 6-storey building, and it has a well-functioning lift with a capacity of about 400 kgs. There is no scope for games, no playgrounds and no dedicated indoor gaming rooms. There is a gym, but it is as good as useless.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2029Offered by Shri Shikshayatan CollegeReviewed on 30 Dec 2025)
reviews.review_heading: Great value for money, very safe for women. Infrastructure is also great.
reviews.review_text: All of the classrooms are smart with smart boards, mic, and other facilities. It is also air-conditioned, although there is only one building, yet all the rooms are well-equipped. There is a library, a physical one, and also an e-library, and there are more than 3-4 labs that have Mac computers and other facilities.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2028Offered by Sarsuna CollegeReviewed on 30 Dec 2025)
reviews.review_heading: College is good, but this college is regular and they don't give study leave for CA and CS exam.
reviews.review_text: The college infrastructure is good. Facilities are available, and they teach us nicely and provide some knowledge. The college canteen is good and cheap in price, but hygiene is not maintained. We have a big college ground. Indoor games are not provided for normal students.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2025Offered by Scottish Church CollegeReviewed on 26 Dec 2025)
reviews.review_heading: Very good infrastructure and experienced faculty.
reviews.review_text: Our classrooms have built in projectors and computers which help teachers to present the slides on the screens. The canteen is really affordable and the food is quite tasty, plus the ambience of the canteen is very soothing. The mess of the hostel is also quite nice.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2029Offered by Asutosh CollegeReviewed on 26 Dec 2025)
reviews.review_heading: Asutosh College can be a good option if you want to pursue a B.Sc. in Statistics in Kolkata.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure are average or above average with almost everything available. The quality of food in the canteen is good. There are proper medical facilities, sports, and the college also encourages students to participate in sports, games, and other activities.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2029Offered by Scottish Church CollegeReviewed on 25 Dec 2025)
reviews.review_heading: It has good faculty members and a campus with a clean and good environment.
reviews.review_text: It has a good campus with a good environment. It is kept clean with good management. There is no ragging, and students need to submit an anti-ragging form beforehand that clearly states rustication as punishment if found guilty of ragging. Seniors are also pretty helpful. Overall, the college has a very nice vibe.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2027Offered by Syamaprasad CollegeReviewed on 6 Dec 2025)
reviews.review_heading: Colleges are good for students.
reviews.review_text: The college infrastructure is good, but not up to the mark. There are Wi-Fi labs, classrooms are large and in good condition, and the library is also good. The hostel is upto the mark, and the canteen's food is below average. No sports arena or gymnasium available.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2029Offered by Vidyasagar CollegeReviewed on 3 Dec 2025)
reviews.review_heading: The college has excellent faculty but poor infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is not good at all. The buildings are very old. Classrooms have old benches and are run-down. The toilets are not clean, and roots are growing out of the walls of the toilets. The library is fine, with the necessary books available. There is a gym available too.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2025Offered by Victoria InstitutionReviewed on 2 Dec 2025)
reviews.review_heading: It is a quiet decent college.
reviews.review_text: It provides labs for practical work. It also provides Wi-Fi. Classrooms are decent. It has both a college and departmental library. The quality of food in the canteen or mess is average, but the price is reasonable. It has medical facilities also. Sports and games are scheduled on the campus.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2028Offered by BESC - The Bhawanipur Education Society CollegeReviewed on 30 Nov 2025)
reviews.review_heading: BESC is the best, as with the slogan of the college, it's true.
reviews.review_text: Best infrastructure and hospitality according to a college. The campus size is average, but its environment is superb. There's no hostel in the college, but the nearby PGS are the best option. You can contact me for that, and I have visited too many Pgs.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2029Offered by St. Xavier's College KolkataReviewed on 29 Nov 2025)
reviews.review_heading: It's one of the best colleges in Kolkata.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi speed is around 200-300 kbps, and as per the classroom, it is well maintained, and the electrical system is in good condition. The library is the best place to study as students can get a personal computer to study there, and people can bring their own electronics for studying. Various bookshelves are there with numerous books to study about the course, and also outside the course.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2025Offered by Prafulla Chandra CollegeReviewed on 25 Nov 2025)
reviews.review_heading: The college has supportive and experienced faculty, structured curriculum, good infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: The department has well maintained classrooms. They properly equipped labs, a good library, and Wi-Fi. It supports the smooth learning. The hostel facilities are comfortable and clean, with decent security. The mess and canteen provides a hygienic and satisfactory food with  variety of options. Medical facilities are accessible when needed. The campus also has good sports and games facilities. It encourages healthy and active lifestyle.

faqs.question: Can I become a lawyer after completing my LLB?
faqs.answer: No, After completing LLB you become a lawyer, however, you are still not an advocate and hence cannot practice law.To become an advocate and to practice law as a profession, you mandatorily need to clear theAll India Bar Examination (AIBE). After qualifying AIBE, one can practice law as a full fledged profession.

faqs.question: Can I start a law practice without a Law degree or become a lawyer?
faqs.answer: No, you cannot become a lawyer without a Law degree.You mandatorily need to obtain degrees such as BA/BCom/BSc/BBA LLB or LLB in order to be a lawyer in India. To become a lawyer, one must first complete three-year or five-year LLB from a recognised university and possess degree certificate. Then, they must enrol themselves in local Bar Council of the concerned state and enrolled as an advocate. Within two years of the enrolment, they must appear and clear AIBE in order to be eligible to practise anywhere in India.

reviews.review_text: We have very big classrooms, and labs are present here. They are very neat, and every room has a CCTV camera. There is a big library with all the books available. Hostel facilities are available, and the rooms are very beautiful. The quality of food is very nice. There are other canteens and a small medical clinic. Sports facilities are also available for students.

reviews.review_heading: Our college has knowledgeable speakers.
reviews.review_text: Our college infrastructure is very nice. However, when it comes to hostels, the infrastructure is good, but their facilities are not as mentioned, and they don't provide perfect management. Coming to our labs and classrooms, everything is very good. Labs are well-maintained by teachers, and they provide us with lots of books in the library.

reviews.review_heading: College is strict, placements are good now, and there are no free classes.
reviews.review_text: The equipment is good, except in the Physics lab. The hostels are clean, as they are recently built. Sometimes, the equipment in the Physics lab gives different readings for different professors. They make us believe their method is right, while other faculty give other methods that give different outputs.

reviews.review_heading: There are no fests and no holidays.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is nice and the classrooms are good. Labs are available, but some systems are not working. It is the first campus and is the best compared to the other branches. We have a big playground to play sports and games.

individual_reviews.title: Small campus but big exploration.

content.Placements: There are so many companies that come to our college. Last year, nearly above 80 companies came. The count of placed students from CE and IT departments is much greater than the ENTC department. Only 10 percent of ENTC students are placed in tech companies. A few ENTC students are placed in Nvidia.
content.Infrastructure: The college provides unlimited Wi-Fi for all students on campus. Individual labs are available for each practical subject. Overall, the campus size is small.

reviews.review_heading: Small campus but big exploration.
reviews.review_text: The college provides unlimited Wi-Fi for all students on campus. Individual labs are available for each practical subject. But classrooms are limited, so we have to compromise on college timing. Because of that, some batches are taken late. The college library is beneficial for students. Overall, the campus size is small.

reviews.review_heading: A step towards my engineering dreams.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure facilities for electronics and telecommunication are not sufficient in PICT. Though the classrooms are big, the labs are not of sufficient size. Medical facilities are not very available, and sports facilities are also not very available because the college has no sports ground. College hostel rooms are good, but the canteen food is not good.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied because of the good placements of the college, and the good placements in 2022.
reviews.review_text: PICT college has a well-established infrastructure with Wi-Fi available throughout the campus and in hostel rooms, modern classrooms, smart lecture halls, well-equipped labs for electronics, communication and computing, and a central library with a rich collection of books and online resources that support both academic and project work. The hostel is pretty good, having 24/7 hot water and Wi-Fi. The mess food is below average, not that good.

reviews.review_heading: Underrated college of Maharashtra.
reviews.review_text: As we know the college campus is quite small i.e., less than 6 acres. So the infrastructure is not as good as the premier institutes in India. But I would say it is still better than most of colleges in Maharashtra that are government. Wi-Fi and labs are great but classrooms and library needs the upgrade for sure. As I don't live in college hostel so I can't give information about college facilities. But they are average as started by my batchmates who are also hostelite in PICT hostel. But my f...

reviews.review_heading: It's the best college for a career, but the worst for overall development.
reviews.review_text: Labs are pretty good. The hostel is okay, but the college canteen is very bad. Sometimes pests are also found in college canteen food. The canteen is totally disgusting.

reviews.review_heading: About Pune Institute of Computer Technology, Pune shines at placements.
reviews.review_text: College provides very good facilities and infrastructure. In our IT department, teachers are highly qualified and very experienced. College also provides high Wi-Fi network in college and lab rooms. Canteen has hygienic food. It has medical facilities. It also has a small ground to play.

reviews.review_heading: College review of PICT of information technology course.
reviews.review_text: All classes, labs, and library have Wi-Fi. All are nice and tidy. The quality of hostel is good. It also has good food quality in the mess and canteen. It has medical facility. Sports ground is quite small, and combined for basketball and volleyball.

reviews.review_heading: Everything is well defined.
reviews.review_text: Our department offers smart classrooms, high-speed Wi-Fi, well-equipped computer labs, and a rich library. Hostels have decent rooms, hygienic mess food, canteen variety, 24X7 medical support, and excellent sports facilities for indoor and outdoor games.

reviews.review_heading: The college has good placements, infrastructure, and facilities.
reviews.review_text: The college provides Wi-Fi for each student. The labs are average in size—not too big or too small. There is also a hostel on campus. Many hostel facilities are available, such as Wi-Fi in each room, water purifiers on each floor, and toilets and bathrooms attached to each hostel room.

reviews.review_heading: PICT Pune – a perfect college for engineering students.
reviews.review_text: Proper facilities are provided by the college, like Wi-Fi, well-equipped labs, spacious classrooms, and a library. The hostel is also sufficient for students, but seats are limited and are filled early. It is better to look for a hostel outside the college. Also, a sports ground is not present.

reviews.review_heading: PICT is a good college with a bad campus but a good technical crowd and above average placements.
reviews.review_text: College has a very small campus area about 4.5 to 5 acres. Also, the infrastructure is not so great still they are making a few changes but building some new floors. The quality of Wi-Fi is good enough but the library is small and can't accommodate more than 25% of college students at a time. The quality of food in the college hostel mess is good enough. But there is no non-veg facility. The sports facility doesn't include all sports. It mostly focused on basketball and volleyball.

reviews.review_heading: It has excellent placements and infrastructure with an industry-relevant curriculum.
reviews.review_text: It has academic facilities like well-equipped laboratories with state-of-the-art infrastructure, modern classrooms with audio-visual aids, and a comprehensive library with a vast collection of books and digital resources. It has a girls hostel with 106 rooms of double occupancy. It has a boy's hostel with 67 rooms of double occupancy.

reviews.review_heading: Pune Institute of Computer Technology (PICT) Review.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is not up to the mark. The area of the college is quite small. Labs and classrooms are well-equipped. A sufficient library is present. Canteen serves decent quality food. A doctor is present all the time on campus. Facilities like gym, indoor games, basketball court, and cricket pitch are available. College hosts and participates in various sports and cultural events, and competitions. The whole campus has Wi-Fi coverage available for students.

reviews.review_heading: PICT - A good or a bad college.
reviews.review_text: College has an average infrastructure. One important thing that all aspiring students should know is that the campus is very small (around 5 acres) for a college in which above 4,000 students study. In terms of sports, there are hardly any good facilities for sports like cricket and football. Most students prefer playing these sports. Speaking about the boy's hostel, the rooms on the 5th floor are really good and have new furniture. The quality of the mess food is the worst.

reviews.review_heading: Detailed review of Pune Institute of Computer Technology, Pune .
reviews.review_text:
The campus of the college is small (5 acres), but all facilities like the computer lab, IEEE lab, graphic lab, printing lab, and fabrication lab are present. The ground is small with Kabbadi, volleyball, basketball, table tennis court, etc. 
I live in a hostel. The hostel is good with about 5 floors.

hostel_campus.college_name: Rustamji Institute of Technology Infrastructure Details & Reviews

hostel.description: Two/ Four seated accommodation facilities are available for the students in the campus premises with separate buildings for men and women. Aesthetically designed, the hostel blocks are spread around the canteen. The hostel has a big ground where basketball/badminton courts are maintained. Each building also having separate mess. Each hostel building has a common room where facilities such as wall-mounted televisions with DTH connection, table-tennis tables, dart game and carom and chess games are available. It is the common room that provides the scene of action for get-togethers, parties and informal discussions. The individual rooms are furnished with teak cots and mattress, a computer table, chairs, closets and shelves. All rooms are facilitated with a balcony.

library.description: The institute has a state of art central library which provides a conductive atmosphere for study. The library collection is well classified and subject wise arranged in a systematic way. At present, the library has a good collection of more than 18000 books. reviews.review_heading: The college is good at all.
reviews.review_text: The hostel and the college infrastructure is good. The Wi-Fi facility is available in college but not in hostel. The labs are well organized in college. The library facilities are best, it is open from 0900 hours to 2400 hours. The quality of food in hostel is good. Sports and games facilities are more provided to hostellers.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Rustamji Institute of Technology.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is good and Wi-Fi will be provided in both the hostel and the college. The classroom is good and still in progress. Some room projectors are there that don't perform. The library is too good. The canteen is near, and the food quality is good. Sports contests are organised at different levels, Nodal, National, state, and district.

reviews.review_heading: My review for Rustamji College.
reviews.review_text: Here, campus life is awesome and full of enjoyment and experience. Students organise many programs like carnival, garba, and many competitions and adventures, which give a good experience of this college. The college provides some of the clubs on its own, like the NSS club, sports club, and NCC club, so students get more advantages.

reviews.review_heading: I am Jaysingh Rana, a student of RJIT College. I completed my B.Tech from this college.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure are well developed, smart classes are available, advanced equipment in labs, and hostel facilities are available with better food. Sport activity is also conducted. RGIT hostel fees are up to 30,000 annually, and medical facilities, such as a doctor, are available.

reviews.review_heading: A well-known college, RJIT, under the BSF.
reviews.review_text: Basically, the infrastructure of my college is small, but in addition, my college is of BSF, so we get their infrastructure, and we can see that there are 2 hostels for boys and 1 for girls, all hostelers live in unity. This is a ragging-free campus and has high discipline.

reviews.review_heading: Decent to average college.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure of the hostel is decent to moderate. For 1st-year boys, rooms have 4 students together. They give a big room with a balcony and, of course, separate beds, table, chair, etc., i.e., basic amenities. For 1st-year girls, rooms have 2 students together. The library is the best part of the campus. You can study there, it is open till 11 PM, so you can utilise your time in learning away from all disturbances.

Sports facilities are also good at RJIT, with some students even going to Nepal and winning in Kabbadi and Football. For those who want to be sportsmen or NCC candidates, this is a good place to be.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Rustamji Institute of Technology.
reviews.review_text: Facilities are good. The infrastructure is good in our course. The full campus has Wi-Fi. Labs are good and smart classrooms are also available. reviews.review_heading: Overall, it is good if you are capable of doing something on your own.

reviews.review_heading: The best college to study at is RJIT.
reviews.review_text: In our college, many facilities are provided for students. A very good infrastructure is available in our course. All campuses have Wi-Fi, labs, and instruments, and instructors are very good. The library is open for 15 hours, and the smart classrooms are available. The hostel facility is very good, and the quality of food available in the mess and canteen is very good. The medical facility and sports and games facility are available.

reviews.review_heading: RJIT shines the future. There are good facilities for the hostel and college infrastructure.

The hostel facilities are good, and the mess food is good. There is a small canteen, and various sports facilities are there. The library is large enough for both personal studies and college studies.

reviews.review_heading: The college is awesome. I like joining the college and learning about everything.
reviews.review_text: The college has smart classes, classrooms, labs and a library for both girls and boys. The quality of mess food is very good and I prefer to live in the hostel to everyone because it's the best thing.

college_info.intro:
The flagship programmes offered at UPES School of Computer Science are BTech and BSc. The college offers these programmes to students at the UG level. Further, the college offers these programmes for a duration of 4 and 3 years, respectively with a comprehensive curriculum. After doing a BSc, students can enter into various industries such as the Oil Industry, Agriculture Industry, and others. Further, BSc graduates can find suitable job roles at Space Research Institutes, Educational Institutes, Wildlife and Fishery Departments, and others.
At UPES School of Computer Science, BTech students will be able to learn to deploy and scale AI-powered applications on various robust cloud platforms. Furthermore, they can look for several career opportunities and can become Mining Engineers, Computer Science Engineers, Lecturers/Professors, Construction Engineers, and others. UPES Computer Science school courses strive to enhance the learning experience of students to prepare them for the industry. reviews_list.review_title: Industry-focused curriculum with great campus life.

review_content.Placements: Placements at UPES are pretty solid. Around 90% of students get placed each year. The top package has gone up to 50 LPA, and the average is about 7 to 8 LPA, and companies like Amazon, Microsoft, Deloitte, PwC, and ONGC hire from here, with roles ranging from engineers and developers to business analysts and legal associates. Placements are a strong point, though internships could be improved.
review_content.Infrastructure: College offers modern infrastructure with Wi-Fi, labs, smart classrooms, and a rich library. Hostels are safe with decent food, medical care is available 24/7, and the campus has strong sports and fitness facilities for an overall balanced student life.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. (Hons.) in Computer Science and Engineering (Cloud Computing and Virtualization Technology) - Batch of 2028
reviews_list.review_title: UPES 2025 updated information, all about infrastructure, placements, facilities, hostel, etc.

review_content.Placements: Usually, in UPES, students get placed with a decent package of around 8 LPA. When it comes to the highest package, it goes above 30 LPA, and average is 8-10 LPA. Many companies come to the college and take students with a good package, but it totally depends on the student whether they will be able to clear it or not.
review_content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is pretty good, and UPES has its own Wi-Fi named UPESNET. It has a good high internet speed, and also the labs and classrooms are not the same as those at CU, GUE, and other private universities. It has far better infrastructure with a good environment, but when it comes to campus hostel, you are charged a lot higher fees, i.e., Rs. 1,94,000 for a triple sharing room, and the food in the mess is not of that good level. As a student who lived on campus for a year, it was very tough to eat that food.

content.Placements: Usually, in UPES, students get placed with a decent package of around 8 LPA. When it comes to the highest package, it goes above 30 LPA, and average is 8-10 LPA. admission_process.title: School of Computer Science Admission Process 2025

paragraphs: School of Computer Science, UPES admissions are primarilymerit-basedfor most of the courses. is a constituent school of theUPES. Formerly known as Centre for Information Technology, the school offers undergraduate, postgraduate and doctoral programmes in various specialisations. The popular offered programmes are BTech and BCA programmes at the undergraduate, MTech at postgraduate and PhD programme at doctoral level. School of Computer Science, UPES admission toBTech, MTech and PhD programmes are entrance-based, whereas, BCA admissions are done on a merit basis. More detailed information around School of Computer Science, UPES admission 2025 are mentioned below:

TheSchool of Computer Science of UPESoffers five under graduate and postgraduate level courses in various disciplines related to Computer Science. Candidates willing to take admission to School of Computer Science courses must check the course-specific eligibility and selection criteria mentioned below:

Candidates seeking admission to the School of Computer Science course must begin the admission process by the minimum requirements to apply for the course. The basic eligibility of undergraduate courses is that the candidates must have passed Class 12 and for postgraduate courses, the candidates must have passed graduation. The detailed course-wise eligibility criteria is stated in the table mentioned above. Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria need to apply for their desired course by visiting the official website of UPES School of Computer Science. The UPES application process is conducted online. Applicants need to pay the specified application fee and submit the application form before the stipulated date.
After successful submission of the UPES Application, candidates need to undergo a course-specific selection process as mentioned below:

Aspirants who clear the selection rounds are offered admission at UPES School of Computer Science. Interested candidates need to pay the seat confirmation fee within the stipulated time to secure their admission.

paragraphs: UPES School of Computer Science offers meritorious students a number of scholarships on the tuition fees to support their education. Students who wish to enroll in any course at UPES Dehradun will have to score a good percentage as a part of the selection process. Apart from this, students should also meet other criteria that the university has chosen to avail the scholarship.

UPES School of Computer Science will provide a concession in fees based on scores scored by students in the entrance exam such as JEE Main, JEE Advanced, CUET, CBSE (+2), and exams from other central/ State boards of India.
The university offers a wide range of scholarships to all students of the University. Some of the UPES Dehradun School of Computer Science scholarship categories and their criteria are listed below:

3. Free Ships Scholarship

The UPES’ Free Ships Scholarships are built to uplift prospective students from low-income families without added clauses or strings attached. A total of 51 seats are allotted with an upper age limit of 20 years for UG programs and 25 years for PG programs - and is provided on both, the tuition fee and hostel fee.
Image source: official website
4. Sports Scholarships

The University allotted 50 seats for sportspeople who excel in a range of sports from cricket, football, and athletics to shooting, chess, and table tennis; as it aims to make sports an inclusive part of the academic curriculum. The scholarship percentile under this impressive initiative ranges from 35% to 100% depending on the number of national & international sports achievements a candidate has.
Image source: official website

This scholarship is applicable for both UG and PG students and for the second year onwards. The scholarship will be awarded to 10% of the total students enrolled in each of the programmes or 1 student whichever is higher. The 10% will be rounded off to the nearest next number. overview_faqs.question: What documents are required for the refund process at SRM Ramapuram?
overview_faqs.answer: The fee refund process at SRM Ramapuram only begins upon receipt of the original documents by the Director of Admissions, Amaravati, either by courier or in person. overview_faqs.question: Does SRM Ramapuram have any fee refund policy?
overview_faqs.answer: SRM Ramapuram fee refund policy is based on UGC guidelines. Candidates get full refund at any time between the academic year of admission. To get the refund, candidates are required to bring an application form signed by the student and their parent and can be submitted in person or online. Candidates get refund to their bank provided in the refund request form. The refund will be processed by RTGS or NEFT.
