reviews.review_heading: Everything is good, neat, and clean. There is no objection to joining the SRM campus.
reviews.review_text: Everything is fine and good. Labs are useful for us. There is Wi-Fi. The hostel food is good, and they will clean daily. The canteen is also good. In case of any emergency, there is a hospital. There are a lot of games and tournaments.

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure but improve hostel food.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is good. The hostel food is not good. It is very bad. Surrounding and campus will be very neat and clean. Students will have a good atmosphere to study. Infrastructure is getting improved day by day. They need to improve the hostel food.

reviews.review_heading: SRM Chennai for B. Tech (CSE).
reviews.review_text: The campus is quite huge, with a lot of places to chill and hang out with friends. There are many food stalls and joints to grab snacks or have lunch together. The entire campus is Wi-Fi enabled. Classrooms are smart. The library has a good stack of all kinds of books. Hostel facility is provided. Many events take place throughout the year, be it hack fests or other co-curricular fests.

reviews.review_heading: I am able to communicate with our alumni seniors regarding companies required to hire.
reviews.review_text: Fully air-conditioned classrooms and the library are accessible to all at any working time. Wi-Fi is installed in each block. Labs are fully equipped, and brand new systems are installed. Hostels are fine and well maintained, and the warden and staff in the hostel are supportive.

reviews.review_heading: A solid start, but success isn’t handed to you.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure at SRM RMP is reliable on campus. Admin and academic blocks are well-maintained. Classrooms are clean. Some rooms are air-conditioned and equipped with basic digital teaching aids. Hostels are generally clean, safe, and well-managed, but the food quality is average with limited variety. Sports facilities exist but are limited.

reviews.review_heading: Students may have some problems as the food is most of the time South Indian cuisine.
reviews.review_text: Well, the faculty members are mostly South Indians, so you must be fluent in English as are most of the students on campus. The labs are decent. Wi-Fi is available across the campus and also in hostels. The food is mid, and there is laundry available each week. The sports campus is decent.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, I will say that the college is very good for those who want to study and get jobs.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is kind of okay. We have all facilities here, such as advanced labs like MLCP, where all the equipment are Apple devices and very high-speed Wi-Fi is available. Classrooms are kind of average, just like normal classrooms, and there is no AC facility. Our college library has various books, but everything is online, so I rarely go there, as the library has an e-book feature available for those who stay far away from college. The hostel is really good, with excellent infrastructu...

reviews.review_heading: The college is good for those who want to study and secure good jobs.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is not that bad. It is somewhere in between. We have MLCP labs that are equipped with Apple devices and high-speed Wi-Fi. Classrooms are kind of average, just like normal classes, with no AC and limited Wi-Fi. Our college library has various books, but since everything is online, I rarely go there. The library also has an e-book feature. The hostel and canteen are really nice and have proper facilities with great-quality food. The mess is okay. We have a sports ...

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely dissatisfied. Too crowded. No proper management. No planning of infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is very poor. I would say it is the lowest all over India. There is no space, and all the buildings are cluttered close to each other. Every time during the start and end of classes, there is a crowd, and it is a very big one. It is the worst. Compared to the KTR campus, it is not even 2% in area of that. The area is very small and holds only 4-5 buildings, like the Ramapuram campus. There are always traffic jams in the morning. It is a very cramped valley way for a university. It...

reviews.review_heading: Good college but with high fees.
reviews.review_text:
Infrastructure:
The infrastructure is awesome, and I loved it when I joined this college. Whatever you want to do on the campus. There are plenty of research labs and facilities available. If students used that for the right purpose. Hostel fee is quite high compared to other colleges, but the facilities and food are so good.

reviews.review_heading: It is a good college for a student who wants to shine in life.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is not actually bad, it's average, that's it, because the students roam anywhere they want, so only the food is okay. Safety is one hundred per cent on my campus, so it's actually good and quite a well-maintained campus, and the hostels in SRM are good.

reviews.review_heading: Great college with excellent faculty, good placements, and strong infrastructure facilities.
reviews.review_text: The campus has excellent infrastructure with modern classrooms, well-equipped labs, and a fully functional library with a wide range of resources. High-speed Wi-Fi is available across the campus. Hostel rooms are clean and comfortable. Mess food is hygienic and provides a variety of dishes, though there is scope for improvement in taste. There are medical facilities, a gym, and sports grounds for cricket, football, and badminton. Overall, the campus provides a good environment for both study and...

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure and peer group. Placements just started for the 2026 batch.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi depends on your luck; some areas and labs have great networks, others not so much. The library isn't much of a library, but it has good computers for things like IEEE site access, which you will need later for paper publication. Classrooms are not bad; all are pretty neat and clean.

reviews.review_heading: You can join SRM Ramapuram.
reviews.review_text: There is very good infrastructure that gives you a peaceful vibe every day. They have a good canteen and food. The canteen makes us feel a vibe. There is a sports complex which has sports facilities like football, cricket, basketball, and other games.

reviews.review_heading: It is one of the best colleges.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is good, and it would have been better if we had basketball courts and football turf. The new building, which has been constructed, has new and well-conditioned ACs, and there are two lifts. The canteen is also properly maintained.

fees_and_eligibility.overview: SAL Education offers various programmes at UG and PG levels. Students can choose Full Time courses from plethora of streams such as Engineering, Medicine & Health Sciences and Business & Management Studies. At the UG level, students can choose from courses, namely B.E. / B.Tech, B.Arch and B.Pharma. On the other hand, at the PG level, the SAL offers M.E./M.Tech, MBA/PGDM and MCA. The fees for SAL courses range between INR 1,43,200 to 5,23,500.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.E. in Computer Engineering - Batch of 2025
reviews_list.review_title: Good placements in 2025. Infrastructure is good.

review_content.Placements: Our batch of B.Tech in computer Science and engineering has around 87% placements. The highest package offered is 12 LPA. Around 75% of students secured internships. Roles offered in top companies are software developer, content developer, software engineer head, and cloud engineer.
review_content.Infrastructure: Our computer science and engineering department offers excellent facilities and infrastructure, including well-equipped computer labs, high-speed Wi-Fi classrooms, libraries, and seminars. We also provide 24 x 7 water, electric, and Wi-Fi service.

reviews_list.batch_info: Bachelor of Pharmacy (B.Pharma.) - Batch of 2026
reviews_list.review_title: I am not satisfied with the placement scheme.

review_content.Placements: There is no placement scheme for pharmacy students. So no one has ever got a placement from campus. They recommend some recruiting companies like Torrent Pharma, Zydus, Sun Pharma, etc., where we have to apply ourselves. I don't know about the internship program but never heard anyone got one from the college.
review_content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of the college is very neat and habitable. Classrooms are equipped with air-conditioners and they are always clean. The projectors are also there. The library is the best place in the college, it's very quiet and peaceful over there. It contains all kinds of pharmacy-related books so we don't have to buy them from outside the market. They don't have Wi-Fi facility though. College doesn't have a boys hostel. The canteen is okay but the food quality is very low. We have a huge ground for sports activities.

overview_faqs.question: Can SAL Education be considered a good college?
overview_faqs.answer: SAL Education is a renowned institution offering Pharm.D, B.Arch, B.Pharma, M.Arch, M.Pharma, MBA/PGDM. Students can choose these courses to embark on their careers in the field of Medicine & Health Sciences, Architecture & Planning, Business & Management Studies. The institute is staffed with highly skilled and experienced faculty members dedicated to delivering these programs. SAL Education boasts an impressive review rating of 4.43 based on student feedback at Shiksha. Additionally, it has received a rating of 4.38 for Campus Life, 4.13 for Placements, 4.75 for Faculty, and 4.25 for Infrastructure.

review_summary.college_name: SAL Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Information Technology - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Overall, everything is good here.

content.Placements: Around 64% students got placed in campus placements, the remaining do businesses, startups and some of them were not eligible for campus placements due to low scores. And after all, it also depends on one's technical skills, if we are unable to deliver the required performance, then it's tough to get selected in campus placements.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is good, but there are 3 colleges in SAL regarding engineering, Saliter, SCE, SETI, in which Saliter & SETI have their own building, but SCE is combined into SALITER and only in 2-4 classes have AC, while the other just have fans. Labs are good, they have AC, but there is only 1 library in between the whole 3 colleges, and college Wi-Fi is limited to labs only.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Good faculty members and decent placements with strong campus life and facilities.

content.Placements: Around 70 percent of students in our course got placed through campus placements. The highest package offered is 12 LPA, the lowest is 3 LPA, and the average package is around 5.5 LPA. Some of the top recruiting companies included TCS, Infosys, Wipro, Capgemini and L&T. Nearly 60 percent for the students got internships in companies like TCS, Cognizant and a few startups during their final year. Top roles offered software developer, data analyst, QA engineer and system administrator. Overall, the placement support and guidance from the faculty members are helpful especially for students who actively participated in training programs.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Engineering - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Good placements in 2025. Infrastructure is good.

content.Placements: Our batch of B.Tech in computer Science and engineering has around 87% placements. The highest package offered is 12 LPA. Around 75% of students secured internships. Roles offered in top companies are software developer, content developer, software engineer head, and cloud engineer.
content.Infrastructure: Our computer science and engineering department offers excellent facilities and infrastructure, including well-equipped computer labs, high-speed Wi-Fi classrooms, libraries, and seminars. We also provide 24 x 7 water, electric, and Wi-Fi service.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Pharmacy (B.Pharma.) - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: I am not satisfied with the placement scheme.

content.Placements: There is no placement scheme for pharmacy students. So no one has ever got a placement from campus. They recommend some recruiting companies like Torrent Pharma, Zydus, Sun Pharma, etc., where we have to apply ourselves. I don't know about the internship program but never heard anyone got one from the college.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of the college is very neat and habitable. Classrooms are equipped with air-conditioners and they are always clean. The projectors are also there. The library is the best place in the college, it's very quiet and peaceful over there. It contains all kinds of pharmacy-related books so we don't have to buy them from outside the market. They don't have Wi-Fi facility though. College doesn't have a boys hostel. The canteen is okay but the food quality is very low. We have a huge ground for sports activities.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Information and Communication Technology - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Great college of engineering.

content.Placements: System analyst, data analyst, network engineer, IT consultant, software developer, web developer, and various roles are offered. Many students get good placements at Sal Education in the ICT branch. From this, you will get a good knowledge of all subjects related to ICT.
content.Infrastructure: Labs and the library are very good. Wi-Fi is a bit poor in the area, but you will get all the needed facilities at Sal Education. There is no hostel for engineering students but classrooms are quite good, air-conditioned, and perfectly cleaned. Overall, the infrastructure is very good.
